title: Vessel permit intake and signed authorizations
not_questions: We will not license Adobe Workfront.
Use the office's sample permit register for the demonstration.
Deliver the pricing schedule as a separate attachment.

questions.label: A.1
questions.text: Describe an AEM Forms application that a boat owner can start before receiving a survey certificate and complete later. Identify what is retained between sessions and show how a reviewer can tell a revised certificate from the copy first uploaded.

questions.label: A.2
questions.text: Explain how AEM Forms would hand a permit request to Salesforce when two vessels share an owner's billing address. Include the keys used to identify the vessel and the evidence a licensing officer would use to resolve a suspected duplicate without discarding a valid application.

questions.label: A.3
questions.text: Show how AEM Forms would handle an application received just before a lock closure takes effect. Set out who owns the decision to pause processing and identify the message an applicant would see if a clerk reopens the case.

questions.label: A.4
questions.text: Provide the AEM Forms pilot script for a low-bandwidth marina office. Explain how the assessor would recognize an interrupted upload, resume the submission and prove that only one complete inspection pack reached the licensing desk.

questions.label: B.1
questions.text: Describe the Acrobat Sign routing order for permits that need both a harbourmaster and a vessel owner's signature.

questions.label: B.2
questions.text: Explain the Acrobat Sign evidence the office could retain if a harbourmaster delegates signing authority for one week.

questions.label: B.3
questions.text: Show how an Acrobat Sign agreement link and final status would be associated with its permit case in Salesforce.

questions.label: B.4
questions.text: Provide a test for an Acrobat Sign agreement withdrawn after the first signature and identify who would verify the withdrawal record.

questions.label: C.1
questions.text: Name the supplier's public sector delivery lead and state how many hours per week the individual has reserved for this contract.

questions.label: C.2
questions.text: List two client references who can discuss your firm's work with regional permitting offices.

questions.label: C.3
questions.text: State your company's fee for a second pilot at a remote lock station and identify the travel costs it includes.

questions.label: C.4
questions.text: Provide your firm's escalation contact for a disputed invoice and the normal time for a written response.
